note: The PostgreSQL that Companion runs privately on a PC, installed by scripts/get-postgres.py: on Windows the official EnterpriseDB build, elsewhere built from the official source. postgresql.org publishes the source's sha256 next to it; EnterpriseDB publishes none, so the Windows sha256 is the one recorded when this version was pinned (downloaded over HTTPS from EnterpriseDB, 2026-10-06). Change every field together, and run the backend tests before committing the bump.
